description.value:
Storm Dragon. The ultimate Raiton: you call existing lightning from a real storm and shape it into a celestial dragon.

Requirements A natural storm is active overhead (GM's discretion; an Uchiha-style Goukakyuu can also create the necessary updraft if cast in the preceding minute).

You designate a point you can see within 300 feet. Lightning travels from the sky to that point at the speed of light. Every creature in a 20-foot burst takes 12d12 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save; the strike also flattens unfortified terrain in the area into a smoking crater of difficult terrain that lasts the encounter.

Casting Kirin without a real storm overhead reduces the damage by half and treats the trigger sky as a 'simulated' source.
